decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 120 Sutton Court Road, Chiswick, London W4 3EQ. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling or used as separate business premises.

Condition : 5 - The conversion of the existing garage to a habitable room and alterations to the building would maintain the existing street scene and amenity of neighbours and is considered to preserve and enhance the appearance and character of the conservation area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Conversion of detached garage to use as habitable room to existing house
